faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Spendoa

items.q: Why does the data change when I switch accounts?
items.a: Each account in Spendoa is independent. When you switch accounts, that account's currency, statistics, and history are loaded.

items.q: Can I transfer money between accounts?
items.a: Yes. You can easily add transfer transactions, such as transferring funds from your cash account to your credit card or savings account.
Yes. You can set a different currency for each account. During transfers, Spendoa fetches live exchange rates and converts automatically.

items.q: How often are exchange rates updated?
items.a: Exchange rates used in transfers are fetched in real-time from global markets as long as you have an internet connection.

items.q: Can I use a shared account?
items.a: Spendoa is designed for individual use. However, you can manage the same data with your partner if you both sign in using the same Google account.

items.q: How do I add installment purchases?
items.a: When adding an expense, select 'Installment Payment.' Enter the total amount and the number of installments; the app will automatically split the amount across months.

items.q: How can I track my debts and receivables?
items.a: Use the 'Debts & Receivables' module in the menu. Add a person to easily track how much you owe or are owed.

items.q: How should I record credit card payments?
items.a: Record them as a 'Transfer' transaction. Transfer money from your bank account to your Credit Card account so your expenses are not counted twice.
Each account has its own recurring income/expense rules. When the scheduled date arrives, the transaction is added automatically.

items.q: What are the benefits of Premium?
items.a: Premium includes features like Financial Score, Future Forecast, Advanced Reports, and Unlimited Accounts. Basic accounting features remain free.
Lifetime is a one-time purchase. Pay once and get lifetime access to all Premium features.

items.q: I purchased Premium but features are not activated?
items.a: Tap 'Restore Purchases' in Settings. If the issue persists, please contact support.

items.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
items.a: Cancel via Google Play Store > Subscriptions. Your benefits will continue until the end of the current billing period.
